# Install paths that are advertised but not yet published.
#
# One id per line (see .github/workflows/install-paths.yml for the id list).
# A path listed here is allowed to fail without failing the workflow — it is a
# known gap, not a regression.
#
# The workflow FAILS if a listed path starts working: that means the package
# shipped and this file plus the README install table are now stale. Delete the
# line to clear it.
#
# Cause: the v0.4.0 release run (2026-06-20) failed in its publish jobs —
# missing Docker Hub / npm / PyPI credentials and an unconfigured `pypi`
# deployment environment. The packages are built and versioned in-tree; nothing
# was ever pushed to the registries.

docker-hub
ghcr
npx
pipx
pypi
npm-sdk
npm-vitest
homebrew
